parts.label: a
parts.technique: Intersection of two lines given in vector form
parts.reason: Vector equation of a line and intersection of lines are explicitly listed as concepts no 9MA0 statement covers, so this is out.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Angle between two lines using dot product
parts.reason: Scalar (dot) product and angle between lines are explicitly excluded concepts not covered by any 9MA0 statement.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Show AB = BC using vector magnitudes
parts.reason: Although magnitude/distance of vectors is ordinary in-spec vector work (P10.2/P10.4), this part requires the point B found in part (a) via line intersection, which is out-of-spec; the part only makes sense after using that out-of-spec answer.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Find position vector of fourth vertex of parallelogram
parts.reason: Requires point B (from out-of-spec intersection in part a) to compute D via parallelogram relation, so depends on an out-of-spec result.
